about.intro_location_text: Located in the Hamburg metropolitan area, with our warehouse in Reinbek, we are ideally positioned at the heart of one of Europe's leading international logistics hubs to supply our client across Europe and worldwide.

about.intro_text_1: We at OSTA Trading GmbH combine our decades of professional experience in pharmaceutical industry and established network of international manufacturers, to create every opportunity for our clients to succeed.
about.intro_text_2: At OSTA Trading GmbH we evolve along with you to meet your requirements.
about.intro_lead: OSTA Trading GmbH is a specialised distributor of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients and specialty ingredients for the pharmaceutical, food and cosmetics industries.
about.services_text_1: We at Osta Trading pride ourselves on offering support to our clients throughout the entire supply process. From manufacturer and product sourcing, to providing logistics solution, warehousing and regulatory support. Thanks to our immense experience inside the pharmaceutical market, we were able to establish a network of not only European, but also global manufacturers. This results in our ability to offer our clients flexible solutions that are tailored to each client's individual technical, regulatory or/and commercial requirements. We don't just supply, we deliver our best.
about.services_text_2: Our business aims to provide every one of our clients with professional pharmaceutical distribution, international sourcing and reliable logistics. Whether our clients require a product for an established commercial project or are searching for a new product for a new developing project, our highly experienced team will assist you with any request, guaranteeing to offer high-quality products at competitive prices.
about.service_manufacturer_text: Suitable APIs and excipients manufacturers. Sources matched to the technical, quality, regulatory and commercial requirements of your project.
about.service_regulatory_text: Coordination of regulatory documentation. Coordinating the regulatory documentation your project requires.
about.service_samples_text: Collection of samples Samples for your evaluation and qualification procedures.

We listen first, then build the supply around your needs.”

That is what we work on every day.”

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers about ordering from OSTA Trading GmbH: availability, quotation requests, documentation, samples, EudraGMDP and GDP, and delivery. Need more detail? Our team will answer your specific request.
faq.q1: What does OSTA Trading GmbH do?
faq.a1: OSTA Trading GmbH is a specialised distributor of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients and specialty ingredients for the pharmaceutical, food and cosmetics industries. Our warehouse is in Reinbek, in the Hamburg metropolitan area, and we supply customers across Europe and worldwide.
faq.q2: Which product groups do you offer?
faq.a2: Our catalogue covers APIs, excipients and food grade ingredients. Browse the product catalogue or the A–Z index, or search by name.
faq.q3: What does “in stock” or “sourcing on request” mean?
faq.a3: Products marked in stock are listed in our catalogue as available. Products marked sourcing on request are not kept in stock: we source them for you from suitable manufacturers. You can request either kind by sending an inquiry.
faq.q4: How do I request a quotation?
faq.a4: Open a product page and use the quotation button, or use the contact form and choose “Request a quote (RFQ)”. Tell us the application, specification, target market, regulatory requirements and expected volumes.
faq.q5: Can you find a product that is not in your catalogue?
faq.a5: Yes. If a product is not in our portfolio, we run a dedicated search for suitable manufacturers, matched to the technical, quality, regulatory and commercial requirements of your project.
faq.q6: Which documents and quality information can I get?
faq.a6: We coordinate the regulatory documentation your project requires and agree specifications and quality requirements with you and the manufacturer before supply starts. The documents available depend on the product and the manufacturer: ask our team about your position.
faq.a7: Yes. We arrange samples for your evaluation and support you up to qualification.
faq.q8: Are you registered in EudraGMDP and do you work to GDP?
faq.a8: OSTA Trading GmbH is registered in EudraGMDP as an API distributor, and our warehouse operates in compliance with GDP requirements.
faq.a9: We coordinate supply from the manufacturer to your destination, including international transport, import and export procedures and shipping documents, together with experienced logistics partners. Our warehouse in Reinbek lets us consolidate supplies and keep stock for selected products.
faq.q10: Are prices shown on the website?
faq.a10: No. Prices and terms depend on the product, quantity and delivery, so they are agreed individually. Send us a request and our manager will get back to you.
